title: Peacock dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- fan tail feathers radiating behind -->
  <g>
    <!-- outer tail fan, teal-green feathers -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='46' ry='40' fill='#1f7a5c'/>
    <!-- feather tips along the fan -->
    <g fill='#3fd6a0'>
      <ellipse cx='12' cy='40' rx='9' ry='13' transform='rotate(-40 12 40)'/>
      <ellipse cx='20' cy='18' rx='9' ry='13' transform='rotate(-20 20 18)'/>
      <ellipse cx='50' cy='8' rx='9' ry='13'/>
      <ellipse cx='80' cy='18' rx='9' ry='13' transform='rotate(20 80 18)'/>
      <ellipse cx='88' cy='40' rx='9' ry='13' transform='rotate(40 88 40)'/>
    </g>
    <!-- eyespots (ocelli) -->
    <g>
      <circle cx='12' cy='40' r='5' fill='#2b3fa0'/>
      <circle cx='12' cy='40' r='2.5' fill='#f2c14e'/>
      <circle cx='20' cy='18' r='5' fill='#2b3fa0'/>
      <circle cx='20' cy='18' r='2.5' fill='#f2c14e'/>
      <circle cx='50' cy='10' r='5' fill='#2b3fa0'/>
      <circle cx='50' cy='10' r='2.5' fill='#f2c14e'/>
      <circle cx='80' cy='18' r='5' fill='#2b3fa0'/>
      <circle cx='80' cy='18' r='2.5' fill='#f2c14e'/>
      <circle cx='88' cy='40' r='5' fill='#2b3fa0'/>
      <circle cx='88' cy='40' r='2.5' fill='#f2c14e'/>
      <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='6' fill='#2b3fa0'/>
      <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='3' fill='#f2c14e'/>
      <circle cx='30' cy='30' r='4' fill='#2b3fa0'/>
      <circle cx='30' cy='30' r='2' fill='#f2c14e'/>
      <circle cx='70' cy='30' r='4' fill='#2b3fa0'/>
      <circle cx='70' cy='30' r='2' fill='#f2c14e'/>
    </g>
    <!-- body: blue peacock -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='14' ry='18' fill='#2b5fd6'/>
    <!-- neck -->
    <rect x='44' y='48' width='12' height='22' rx='6' fill='#3a7bea'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='46' r='8' fill='#3a7bea'/>
    <!-- crest -->
    <g fill='#4ff0c0'>
      <circle cx='46' cy='37' r='2'/>
      <circle cx='50' cy='35' r='2'/>
      <circle cx='54' cy='37' r='2'/>
    </g>
    <!-- beak -->
    <polygon points='57,46 63,48 57,50' fill='#f2c14e'/>
    <!-- eye -->
    <circle cx='53' cy='45' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <!-- dancing wings lifted -->
    <ellipse cx='34' cy='60' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#1f49a8' transform='rotate(-25 34 60)'/>
    <ellipse cx='66' cy='60' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#1f49a8' transform='rotate(25 66 60)'/>
    <!-- dancing legs -->
    <line x1='46' y1='84' x2='40' y2='95' stroke='#f2c14e' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='54' y1='84' x2='60' y2='93' stroke='#f2c14e' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
</svg>
